name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Mirror Acrylic Standing
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality 1-layer mirror acrylic, offering a sleek, elegant, and eye-catching decorative finish.
    - Made from 3mm thick mirror acrylic, providing a lightweight yet sturdy structure for tabletop display.
    - Includes:
            +) Main Piece – Mirror Acrylic 3mm
            +) Base – Mirror Acrylic 3mm
    - Available in Gold Mirror Acrylic and Silver Mirror Acrylic options.
    - The reflective surface creates a luxurious and modern appearance, making the piece stand out beautifully on desks, shelves, countertops, and display tables.
    - Designed as a freestanding decorative keepsake with a clean and polished look.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Product size: 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Engraving Technology:
    - This product is made from 1-layer mirror acrylic and finished using precision laser cutting and engraving technology.
    - The final design can be created in 2 style options:
            +) Cut Out
            +) Engrave
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative tabletop sign and a personalized keepsake display.
    - Designed for use on desks, shelves, countertops, office tables, classroom desks, and display cabinets.
    - Suitable for home décor, office décor, patriotic displays, teacher appreciation gifts, milestone celebrations, and themed events.
    - The freestanding base allows the product to be displayed securely on flat surfaces without additional support.
    - Perfect for adding a stylish, modern, and personalized touch to any space.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for teachers, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, holidays, patriotic celebrations, appreciation gifts, back-to-school gifts, and special occasions.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves elegant personalized décor and reflective acrylic keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for home décor, desk décor, office accents, and milestone event displays.
    - Great for commemorative gifts, celebration décor, and meaningful personalized displays.
    - Adds a sleek, stylish, and memorable touch to any space🎁

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
